sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def snap(f):
    out=[]
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']; rows=[p[0] for p in b]; cols=[p[1] for p in b]
        out.append((n['color'], min(rows), max(rows), min(cols), max(cols)))
    return out
res = action(['UP']*2)
print("top le36:", snap(current_frame))
print({k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('level_completed','game_over','done','run_complete')})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
